title: Intermolecular Forces
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Intermolecular force comparison using models and boiling point/property data. No liquid testing is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for bonding models, molecular geometry, ionic/covalent comparisons, and intermolecular forces
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the two-atom or three-atom molecule screen that matches the lesson example. Turn on bond dipoles, molecular dipole, or partial-charge indicators if those controls are available. Change atom electronegativity or molecular shape one variable at a time. Record the bond polarity evidence, overall molecule polarity evidence, and how that evidence affects intermolecular attraction.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: OpenStax Chemistry 2e; PhET molecule polarity resources
